Dental implants are one of the most predictable solutions for replacing missing teeth. Unlike removable dentures or conventional dental bridges, implants replace the missing tooth root with a titanium implant placed in the jawbone. Once the implant integrates with the surrounding bone, a crown, bridge, or full-arch restoration can be attached to restore function and appearance.
